subject_message: fix(macos): terminate owned process groups via host helper
summary: Bounded correction to the parent ACT. (P0-A) The prior §12 cross-client test was structurally invalid: it used client A's client_token as if it were a job_token, so the helper's DENY_UNKNOWN_JOB response was structurally indistinguishable from ordinary unknown-job rejection. Re-ran the OLD discriminator against the live helper and reproduced the same invalid shape (01-old-discriminator-red.txt). Built the corrected discriminator: (i) opened a real helper client via the production wire provider; (ii) registered the SAME PGID for that client so we have a real, A-owned job_token JA; (iii) spawned a SEPARATE Bun subprocess (different kernel peer_pid) that opens its OWN helper client and attempts terminate(CB, JA_real) — the helper correctly returns DENY_FOREIGN_JOB; (iv) verified A's PGID still alive after B's rejected attempt; (v) had A invoke terminate(CA, JA_real) — TERMINATED_TERM; (vi) verified A's PGID is now gone. (P0-B) Relabeled the seam honestly: SYNTHETIC_REAL driver + REAL_PRODUCTION_FUNCTION (CommandJobManager + provider + wire) + REAL_LAUNCHAGENT + REAL_KERNEL + REAL_EXTENSION_HOST = LIVE_UNOBSERVABLE (no codium-clinemm extension-host was launched). Per §11, LIVE_UNOBSERVABLE is acceptable; the narrower classification is honestly bound to evidence.

corrections.defect: Discriminator used client_token in job_token slot. The helper returned DENY_UNKNOWN_JOB because no job was ever registered under that 32-hex string; this is structurally indistinguishable from ordinary unknown-job rejection and does NOT prove foreign-ownership enforcement.
corrections.fix: Constructed a real A-owned job via CommandJobManager.start() + wire.registerOwned() so the helper issues a real (clientTokenA, jobTokenJA) pair. Spawned a separate Bun subprocess (peer_pid_B != peer_pid_A) that opens its own client_token_B and attempts terminate(CB, jobTokenJA_real). Helper returned DENY_FOREIGN_JOB — the canonical foreign-ownership denial. PGID_A still alive after B's rejected attempt (foreign-group conservation). A's positive-control terminate(CA, JA) returned TERMINATED_TERM and PGID_A is now gone.

corrections.defect: The driver is a standalone Bun harness that directly imports production modules and forces CLINEMM_EXPERIMENTAL_SANDBOX='off' before instantiation. It does not exercise the extension-host lifecycle (codium-clinemm → vscode-session-host → task creation → CommandJobManager).
corrections.fix: Honestly rebound the seam labels per §10: COMMANDJOBMANAGER_CODE = REAL_PRODUCTION_FUNCTION; HELPER_ADAPTER = REAL_PRODUCTION_FUNCTION; LAUNCHAGENT = REAL | LIVE; KERNEL_SIGNALING = REAL | LIVE; DRIVER = SYNTHETIC_REAL; REAL_EXTENSION_HOST_END_TO_END = NOT_EXECUTED. Per §11, attempted no intrusive instrumentation and recorded REAL_EXTENSION_HOST_WIRING = LIVE_UNOBSERVABLE.

passing_gates: A_REGISTRATION (real CommandJobManager.start issued a job with running state, pgid > 0, leader_pid == pgid)
A_JOB_TOKEN_REAL (helper issued a 32-hex-char job_token for the registered PGID)
TARGET_A_BOUNDED (the registered PGID is bounded by the helper's authority check)
B_PEER_PID_DIFFERS (peer_pid_B != peer_pid_A; subprocess B is a different kernel peer)
B_USING_A_REAL_JOB_TOKEN_DENY (B's terminate(CB, JA_real) was correctly denied)
B_FOREIGN_JOB_ERROR (the canonical cross-ownership denial code was returned: DENY_FOREIGN_JOB)
A_GROUP_AFTER_B_ATTEMPT (A's PGID is still alive after B's rejected attempt — no signal mutation)
A_OWN_TERMINATION (A's terminate(CA, JA_real) was correctly allowed and returned TERMINATED_TERM)
CLIENT_SLOT_BASELINE (the /tmp secret file containing raw tokens was removed in step 6)
JOB_SLOT_BASELINE (A's PGID is gone after the owner positive control)

cross_client_isolation_proof.shape: B + JA_real -> DENY_FOREIGN_JOB ; A + JA_real -> ALLOW (TERMINATED_TERM)

parent_act_rebind.CLIENT_ISOLATION: LIVE PASS (corrected discriminator with real JA)
